rulings.Case Title: SWORDS TO PLOWSHARES, A CALIFORNIA NON-PROFIT VS. DONALD GILLSON ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motioin For Threshold Jurisdictional - Federal Enclave/Standing
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for August 27, 2026. Line 7. DEFENDANT DONALD GILLSON Notice Of Motion And Motioin For Threshold Jurisdictional - Federal Enclave/Standing is DENIED. While not clear, it appears that Defendant either requests that (1) this Court determine the subject matter jurisdiction of the federal courts or that (2) this Court determine that this Court does not have subject matter jurisdiction. As to the first issue, this Court does not determine the parameters of the federal court's subject matter jurisdiction. See Plowshares v. Kemp (2005) 423 F.Supp.2d 1031. Such determinations are made by federal courts. As to the second issue, moving party cites no authority for the proposition that this Court lacks subject matter jurisdiction. =(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849).
